notes: Variant assumption is a conventional straight-bar floor pull with hands outside the legs. Primary roles were limited to erector spinae, quadriceps, and gluteus maximus because direct EMG and review evidence show large trunk and knee-extensor demand in addition to hip extension. Hamstrings remain secondary. Latissimus dorsi was not added because exact conventional-deadlift evidence reviewed here did not support it as cleanly as the selected support muscles. No anatomy blockers found.
